thread:
rachel: noticed a failed cross-account restore in canary: decrypt error "invalid-encryption-context" when restoring tenant snapshots from partner-account archive. looks like EncryptionContext was missing on the copy.
omid: timeline? which job did the copy?
rachel: partner's transfer tool ran at 04:10UTC and copied objects into our bucket using a role that was impacted by last week's RBAC normalization. head-object shows ServerSideEncryption=aws:kms but no x-amz-server-side-encryption-context header recorded in access logs.
nate: do we have the original request logs from their side showing context? if they sent it and it got stripped, that's on our proxy.
infra: checking proxy logs now. proxy accepted incoming copy with ctx present, but when proxy assumed our proxy-role to perform the PutObject the role's session policy removes unrecognized headers. looks like a deny-list enforcement removed the EncryptionContext key.
sec-bot: alert: encryption-context-scrub detected (rule: s3-encryption-context-presence). incident created ENC-2025-310.
omid: immediate actions: 1) stop cross-account copy job (partner contacted), 2) re-grant proxy-role permission to forward encryption-context via session policy, or add explicit allow for s3:PutObject with x-amz-server-side-encryption-context condition, 3) run audit to find objects missing context and mark them non-restorable until fixed.
rachel: audit query I ran returned 12 keys across the partner import prefix. saving to /tmp/partner_missing_ctx.txt.
nate: remediation options: if partner still has originals we can ask them to re-copy after role fix. Alternatively, if we have account master key and policy allows re-encrypt, we can server-side copy to rewrap with correct EncryptionContext but that will not match tenant CMEK context so might be unacceptable.
infra: plan to patch session policy and roll back last week's RBAC enforcement that pruned header passthrough. I will coordinate with partner to pause and retry copies.
sec-bot: compliance-note: notify compliance and legal; these tenants require encryption context for key-use audits.
omid: add test in integration suite: cross-account copy should preserve encryption context and head-object must include EncryptionContext header. also add alert when any completed PutObject from partner prefix lacks encryption-context.
rachel: created incident and started postmortem doc draft. will prepare CS template in case tenants need notification. thanks all. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: ENC-2025-310 created: https://redwood.incidents/ENC-2025-310
